scheme_name: Financial Assistance To The Child Victims Of Violence Under TheNational Foundation For Communal Harmony
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a domicile/permanent resident of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir
Applicant must be an orphan or destitute child
The child's main bread earner must have been killed or permanently incapacitated in communal, caste, ethnic or terrorist violence
Applicant must not be receiving any regular assistance from any other source (one‑time assistance by the State/UT is exempt)
benefits_summary: Provides monthly education allowance (₹800 in Class A & B cities, ₹750 elsewhere) plus ₹150 vocational training allowance, accident insurance up to ₹25,000 and medical expense reimbursement of ₹500 per child.
